title: Sadak mo wayli hoddiro
intro: E balɗe gadane neɗɗaagu, ruuhu ina rokka dokkal e anniyaaji laaɓtuɗi. Kono, enɗam ina ɓuuɓtoo e ŋoral jaɓde. Yiytu daartol ngol limre nde dewal mum e joofnirde mum mettunde ina maayna e nder wahyu Alla.
clues: Miɗo jeyaa e yontaaji gadani aadee en.
Mi sakkitii Joomiraawo am sadak, ɗum jaɓɓaama e moƴƴere.
Sadak miñi am jaɓaaka, enɗam niɓɓiɗi ɓernde makko.
Mi wi’i mo, So a fooɗii junngo maa feewde e am ngam warde mi, mi weetataa junngo am warde ma; goonga miɗo hula Alla, joom adunaaji ɗii.”
Mi wonti cokaaɗo e golle warngooji gadani e dow leydi.
Ƴiiƴam am wulli, ko miin woni martiri gadano mo alaa ko boni.

trial.label: Ñaawoore/Kewu
options: Sadak makko jaɓaa, addani miñiiko yiɗde e warde mo
O werlaa e nder lowre huɓɓunde kono o yalti ko o bonnaani
O mahi laana mawka e les njiimaandi Alla
Liingu mawngu moɗi mo, o woni e niɓɓere
O ardi yimɓe maako nder maayo ceccoongo
trial.answer: Sadak makko jaɓaa, addani miñiiko yiɗde e warde mo

outcome.label: Keeɓal
options: Warngo adanngo e nder daartol; miñiiko ñaawaa
Leydi muusi ɗum wondude e jawdi mum
Halki ɗum ko henndu ɓuuɓndu, ɓuuɓndu
Njokkii e ilam mawɗam ko jukkungo
outcome.answer: Warngo adanngo e nder daartol; miñiiko ñaawaa

arabic: ۞ وَٱتْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ نَبَأَ ٱبْنَىْ ءَادَمَ بِٱلْحَقِّ إِذْ قَرَّبَا قُرْبَانًۭا فَتُقُبِّلَ مِنْ أَحَدِهِمَا وَلَمْ يُتَقَبَّلْ مِنَ ٱلْـَٔاخَرِ قَالَ لَأَقْتُلَنَّكَ ۖ قَالَ إِنَّمَا يَتَقَبَّلُ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ
verse: And recite to them the story of Adam's two sons, in truth, when they both made an offering [to Allāh], and it was accepted from one of them but was not accepted from the other. Said [the latter], "I will surely kill you." Said [the former], "Indeed, Allāh only accepts from the righteous [who fear Him]. (5:27)
